sample_data_caveats: Alpaca IEX minute bars are research-only rather than consolidated SIP evidence.
A prior implementation opened the reserved 102-session holdout despite failing the validation gate; those results are invalidated.
Both corrected model families win only one of three validation folds and are diagnostic shadow artifacts, not research-pass models.
capacity_assessment: Models cannot create entries or submit orders. Any future TQQQ Paper use still requires spread, gap, ADV, and observed fill review.
notes: Eight fixed Logistic and LightGBM trials use index-minus-one features, chronological expanding folds, episode-end purge, a 13-bar embargo, and reference-engine turnover costs. The corrected selection contract requires two fold wins, positive IR, aggregate return or Sharpe lift, and non-worse drawdown before holdout access. No family qualifies, so the holdout is not evaluated and the rule remains champion.
